lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11-12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso with compression observed toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most stripe and the two posterior-most stripes are abbreviated, terminating mid-mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 3 high-contrast circular spots visible on the upper posterior haunch.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking on the bridge of the snout, two distinct white spots on the lateral face, and a broad white patch at the base of the throat.
